headline: Week 1 Stalemate: SBF Opens 2026 With Five Goose Eggs and Zero Bragging Rights
html:
Week 1 Stalemate: SBF Opens 2026 With Five Goose Eggs and Zero Bragging Rights

Week 1 in Stumblin Bumblin & Fumblin delivered a scoreboard only a defense could love: every team finished on 0.0 points, leaving all five matchups tied and the standings untouched at 0-0-0. Nobody won, nobody lost and nobody earned permission to talk trash. For now, the official SBF Network power board is doing all the separating.

Week 1 Matchups

Chase’n Skattehoes 0.0, arupert12 0.0

A scoreless tie means Ja'Marr Chase and company share the same Week 1 fate as the Jefferson-Taylor-Hurts core: no result and no advantage. arupert12 holds the higher official power ranking at No. 3, while Chase’n Skattehoes sits No. 7, but the scoreboard treated them like identical twins.

OguguaAnunoby 0.0, Secret service chat 0.0

Jahmyr Gibbs and the No. 4-ranked OguguaAnunoby lineup could not separate itself from No. 9 Secret service chat. Both leave Week 1 with 0.0 points and a tie that technically avoids disaster while accomplishing absolutely nothing.

Kirkumcised Penix 0.0, shmeems 0.0

The official No. 2 team and No. 8 team ended in the same place: parked at zero. Kirkumcised Penix brought the stronger power score into the matchup, but Week 1 awarded no style points for roster construction.

Chef Boyardee 0.0, Allen town 0.0

Allen town entered at No. 5 on the official board, five spots ahead of Chef Boyardee, and still walked away with the same score. The Chef avoided an opening-week loss, but the kitchen did not produce a single scoreboard point.

alexvandeusen 0.0, Al-Qaeda Crashouts 0.0

The official championship favorite opened against the No. 6 team and finished in a scoreless tie. alexvandeusen remains the team to beat according to the official board, but Week 1 gave the favorite no victory lap and the underdog no upset.

Biggest Win and Closest Game

  • Biggest win: None. Every matchup ended 0.0-0.0.
  • Closest game: All five matchups tied with a margin of 0.0 points.

1. alexvandeusen

Power score: 94. McCaffrey, Achane, Hall, Collins, Bowers and Burrow form an elite, balanced lineup, with Mahomes, Andrews and Godwin supplying exceptional depth.

2. Kirkumcised Penix

Power score: 91. Daniels, Lamb, Henry and Cook headline a loaded starting core, while McLaurin, Flowers, Kelce, Pollard and Purdy provide strong depth.

3. arupert12

Power score: 89. Jefferson, Taylor and Hurts anchor a balanced lineup featuring Olave, Higgins, Montgomery, Warren and Kraft, with Murray offering premium quarterback insurance.

4. OguguaAnunoby

Power score: 86. Gibbs leads an excellent backfield with Walker and Jacobs, complemented by London, Metcalf and Kittle; Maye and inexperienced receivers add uncertainty.

5. Allen town

Power score: 83. Allen, Bijan and Hampton create elite quarterback-running back upside, while Smith and Jameson Williams lead a solid but less proven receiving group.

6. Al-Qaeda Crashouts

Power score: 81. Amon-Ra, A.J. Brown and McBride provide elite receiving strength, supported by Kyren and Bucky; Dart is the lineup’s clearest uncertainty.

7. Chase’n Skattehoes

Power score: 78. Ja'Marr Chase headlines a deep receiving corps with McConkey, Pickens and Harrison, but the running backs and Fannin carry more projection risk.

8. shmeems

Power score: 75. Lamar, Puka, Rice and LaPorta offer a strong ceiling, but the starting backfield relies heavily on young, uncertain options and Swift.

9. Secret service chat

Power score: 72. Smith-Njigba and Jeanty provide star upside alongside Dak, Adams and Etienne, though Pitts and several starters have wider preseason outcome ranges.

10. Chef Boyardee

Power score: 69. Saquon, Nabers and Garrett Wilson form a powerful foundation, but Lawrence and a highly inexperienced starting backfield beyond Saquon reduce lineup certainty.

Fraud Watch

  • alexvandeusen: The official favorite has elite balance and exceptional depth, but a 0.0-point tie means the crown remains entirely theoretical.
  • Kirkumcised Penix: A 91 power score looks imposing. The Week 1 scoreboard looked like somebody forgot to plug it in.
  • Every would-be trash talker: When the entire league scores zero, screenshots of the standings belong in the comedy section.

Stock Up

  • alexvandeusen: No win was recorded, but the official board still places this lineup first with a 94 power score and +425 championship odds.
  • Kirkumcised Penix: The loaded starting core and strong depth earn the No. 2 ranking, a 91 power score and +525 odds.
  • arupert12: A balanced lineup anchored by Jefferson, Taylor and Hurts holds the No. 3 position with an 89 power score.

Stock Down

  • Chef Boyardee: The official board places the Chef 10th with a 69 power score, citing uncertainty at quarterback and in the starting backfield beyond Saquon.
  • Secret service chat: Star upside is present, but wider preseason outcome ranges leave the team ninth with a 72 power score.
  • Week 1 bragging rights: Completely worthless. Every matchup was a tie.

Weekly Awards

  • Top of the Mountain: alexvandeusen, ranked No. 1 with a 94 power score.
  • Best of the Rest: Kirkumcised Penix, ranked No. 2 with a 91 power score.
  • Photo Finish Award: The entire league, after five identical 0.0-0.0 ties.
  • Transaction Desk Award: Chef Boyardee and Al-Qaeda Crashouts completed the supplied trade, with Trevor Lawrence going to Chef Boyardee and Tyler Bass going to Al-Qaeda Crashouts.
  • Waiver Wire Frequent Flyer: Secret service chat, which appears repeatedly among the supplied completed free-agent and waiver transactions.
  • Participation Trophy: All 10 teams. Nobody lost, but nobody did anything scoreboard-worthy either.

Commissioner’s Closing Message

Week 1 is in the books, although “in the books” is doing heroic work for five 0.0-0.0 ties. Check your lineups, monitor the listed questionable tags and prepare for the next scoring period. The official rankings have established the pecking order; now somebody needs to score a point and make this league earn its name.
